rows.finding: Heise’s Plumbing publishes an Ingleside tub W&O replacement using exterior-ceiling access.
rows.recommendation: Use as the first plumbing-specialist screening call; require a separate written drywall/restoration scope.

rows.finding: Rapid Flow, Ace, We Do Construction and Save-On-Interior show active B + C36 classifications.
rows.recommendation: Ask each for one contract covering the actual plumbing and drywall performers, exact repair experience and occupied-unit references.

rows.finding: Bernal Hill Drywall shows active C-9 + B and advertises small repairs, patching and texture matching.
rows.recommendation: Screen as the drywall/build-back partner under a general contractor or coordinated single prime; no C36 on its license.

rows.finding: The three owner-reported scopes are adjustment, lever/diverter replacement and W&O replacement.
rows.recommendation: Do not rank by price. Normalize the scope and obtain written access/restoration inclusions first.

rows.finding: A manufacturer example supports tub-side linkage service on specified models.
rows.recommendation: Ask for a non-destructive, model-specific assessment first; do not assume prior failed attempts can be repeated safely.

rows.finding: The owner reports below-ceiling access may be needed; a local company documents a similar access route.
rows.recommendation: Require opening location, protection, restoration and future-service access in the written scope before authorization.

rows.finding: We Do Construction, SF Building Group and Ayoob & Peery emphasize larger/design-build or commercial work.
rows.recommendation: Keep as secondary candidates until small isolated-repair acceptance is confirmed.

rows.finding: Save-On-Interior and Bay Area Plumbing share CSLB address and phone, but that does not prove common ownership or one combined contract.
rows.recommendation: Treat as separate license records; confirm the contracting entity and actual performers.

rows.finding: Kenneth Asire is suspended; Advanced carries a future-suspension warning; D G has complaint disclosure.
rows.recommendation: Exclude suspended work; review official adverse/additional-status records before considering the others.

rows.finding: No provider has confirmed availability, exact-job acceptance or a combined price in this research.
rows.recommendation: The output is a verified screening shortlist, not a booked service or guaranteed repair outcome.

rows.finding: Yelp links support discovery, but direct numeric review data was blocked or inconsistent across excerpts.
rows.recommendation: Ratings and counts remain blank; read current reviews and request job-specific references.

rows.finding: Multiple prior public drafts disagree on counts, prices, canonical route and verification strength.
rows.recommendation: Use the root dashboard as canonical; preserve old work in Git and redirect superseded public HTML routes.
